title: 第025章 唯一奇观 永恒之塔第026章 红色词条 无限进化
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 聊天频道的风暴，苏业不是很清楚，不过就算知道了也就那样。
战力榜是永恒世界意志排名的，苏业也是隐藏了的，没有泄露自己的信息，所以哪怕飙升也不怕被人找到。
不可能找到自己，一点信息也没有，哪怕是有占卜系的兵种存在，也无法推算自己的存在，除非苏业自己蠢。
将自己曝光了，否则想要靠占卜找到苏业，那是绝对不可能的事情。
苏业走出神圣圣堂，看着自己领地之中的景象。
基因禁军悠闲的坐在灵源湖畔旁闲聊，原罪堕天使和纯血堕天使互相在湖中嬉戏打闹，太古黑金巨龙如同一颗炮弹一样砸入灵源湖中，随后从湖底一跃而起，掀起水浪。
塔丽丝安静的坐在湖边，身边是潘吉利娅。
伊斯塔则是与凯莎并肩而行，莉莉丝则是慵懒的躺在湖边。
一切都是那么的和谐。
苏业看到这一幕笑了笑，随后也不在意，手中浮现出一座金色的巨塔，唯一奇观：永恒之塔。
姓名：永恒之塔
等级：唯一
特性：永恒之光
ps：唯一属性的奇观，能够凝聚永恒之光，让兵种不断的进化的，奇迹型奇观。
“只有一个特性的唯一奇观？”苏业摸着下巴看着手中的永恒之塔模型。
随后查看了一下唯一的特性永恒之光到底有什么用。
永恒之光：具有永恒不朽的属性，能够不断强化提升你兵种肉身强度，凝聚永恒不朽的神体！！！
“很好，很强大！！”苏业看着永恒之塔的属性，简单粗暴，但是有效。
提升兵种肉身强度，甚至凝聚永恒不朽的神体，从这一个属性来说，永恒之塔就不愧为唯一属性的奇观。
要知道兵种虽然是招募出来的，但是都是有血有肉的存在，肉身的强弱一直都存在。
比如说潘吉利娅和莉莉丝两人之间相比，潘吉利娅虽然是黑铁1星，但是肉身强度远远不是莉莉丝能比的。
永恒不朽的神体是什么概念，那就相当于苏业的兵种，人均凝聚了永恒神性，这才是永恒之塔最恐怖的一点。
哪怕肉身在孱弱的兵种，在永恒之塔的照耀下，也会发生蜕变，最后化作坚不可摧的永恒不朽神体，凝聚出永恒神性。
苏业心念一动，手中的金色巨塔直接化作一轮金色的大日高悬在了苏业的领地上空。
金色的大日高悬在苏业的领地之中。
莉莉丝等人也发现了这轮金色的大日，随后隐没在了虚空之中，苏业领地之中多了一丝说不清道不明的东西。
苏业知道，那是永恒之光的作用，在自己的领地之中的兵种，随着时间的流逝，迟早会凝聚永恒不朽的神性。
这是一个漫长的时间，但是这一切都值得等待。
content_en:
Su ye wasn't very clear about the storm in the chat channel, but even if he knew about it, that was it.
The combat power list is ranked by the will of the eternal world. Su ye also hid it and did not leak his information, so he was not afraid of being found even if it soared.
It is impossible to find him, there is no information at all, even if there are divination-type troops, there is no way to deduce his existence, unless Su ye is stupid.
After exposing himself, otherwise it would be absolutely impossible to find Su ye through divination.
Su ye walked out of the sacred church and looked at the scene in his territory.
The Genetic Forbidden Army sat leisurely by the Lingyuan Lake and chatted. The original sin fallen angels and the pure-blooded fallen angels were playing and quarreling with each other in the lake. The ancient black gold dragon smashed into the Lingyuan Lake like a cannonball, and then jumped up from the bottom of the lake, causing waves.
Talis sat quietly by the lake, with Pangeliya next to her.
Ishtar was walking side by side with Kesha, while Lilith was lying lazily by the lake.
Everything is so harmonious.
Su Ye smiled when he saw this scene, and then he didn't care. A huge golden tower appeared in his hand. The only wonder: the Tower of Eternity.
Name: Tower of Eternity
Level: unique
Features: Eternal Light
ps: The only attribute of the wonder is that it can condense the eternal light and allow the troops to continuously evolve. It is a miraculous wonder.
"The only wonder with only one characteristic?" Su ye touched his chin and looked at the model of the Tower of Eternity in his hand.
Then I checked what the only characteristic, eternal light, was for.
Eternal Light: It has the attribute of eternal immortality, which can continuously strengthen and improve the physical strength of your troops, and condense the eternal and immortal divine body! ! !
"Very good, very powerful!!" Su ye looked at the properties of the Tower of Eternity. It was simple and crude, but effective.
It can enhance the physical strength of the soldiers, and even condense the eternal immortal divine body. From this attribute, the Tower of Eternity is worthy of being a wonder with the only attribute.
You must know that although the soldiers are recruited, they are all flesh and blood, and the strength and weakness of the physical body always exist.
For example, comparing Panjilia and Lilith, although Panjilia is a 1-star Black Iron, her physical strength is far beyond what Lilith can match.
What is the concept of an eternal and immortal divine body? It is equivalent to Su ye's military unit. Each person has condensed eternal divinity. This is the most terrifying thing about the Tower of Eternity.
Even the physically weak soldiers will undergo transformation under the illumination of the Tower of Eternity, and finally transform into an indestructible and immortal divine body, condensing the eternal divinity.
With a thought in Su ye's mind, the golden tower in his hand turned into a golden sun and hung high over Su ye's territory.
The golden sun hung high in Su ye's territory.
Lilith and others also discovered this golden sun, which then disappeared into the void. There was something inexplicable in Suye's territory.
Su ye knew that it was the effect of eternal light. The troops in his territory would sooner or later gather eternal divinity as time went by.
It's been a long time coming, but it's been worth the wait.
